pairs.evidence: app/_landing/cosmos/engine/nav.ts:196 Cosmos implements an internal multi-level navigation and back stack within a browser tab without integrating into the browser's history or address, causing the browser Back gesture to leave the application rather than traverse sections.

techniques.evidence: app/_landing/cosmos/engine/nav.ts:196 Cosmos maintains a private back-navigation function and HUD button that modifies internal state without updating browser history or listening to popstate, violating the rule that within a browser tab the host's back gesture must consult the shell's history.
